newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse continues bearish, quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse continues bearish, quiet trading.

text.p: The 20-share index fell on Friday at the Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE), reflecting a bearish market, brokers and bourse officials said.
The index fell 6.42 points to stand at 3046.55. Turnover was posted at 9.937 million shillings traded on 614,678 shares from 24.349 million shillings traded on 370,114 shares on Thursday.

Agriculturals were all quiet; 12,439 shares of Rea Vipingo Plantations were traded at an unchanged 10.10. Rea Vipingo has been the most actively traded agricultural share this week with more than 118,000 shares dealt.
A single lot of 400,000 shares of Standard Newspapers Group was traded on the three-day special board at a reserve price of 10 shillings, a premium of 2.40 from the ordinary floor.

Brokers said the share price of Standard Newspapers had been fluctuating between 6.55 and 7.50 in the past two weeks and buyers' acceptance to buy at a premium was based on speculation that the price would rise -- given the newspaper group posted a profit this year, reversing losses of the previous year.

In financials, National Bank of Kenya traded 23,325 shares at 14.30 from 14.45, Barclays traded at 96 from 97 -- its lowest price in the last 12 months, while Standard Chartered Bank traded at an unchanged 46.

"Small investors prefer to buy lower priced shares because they are more affordable. National Bank's profitability has improved since new management took over in 1993, and this could explain the continued investor interest," a senior broker said.

"Another reason is, compared to Barclays and Standard Chartered Bank who can only trade about 20 percent of their total capitalisation, National Bank has about 77.5 percent tradeable on the stock exchange," he added.

Brokers expected the forthcoming period to be guided by announcements of company results in Lonrho Motors and East African Portland Cement, who, according to past records, issue their results sometime in September and October.
